title: yt-dlp dump-json can omit video language even when captions exist
claims_under_test: --dump-json metadata can have null language fields while subtitles or automatic_captions are populated.
With missing video language, prefer uploaded subtitle keys (except live_chat/danmaku), then -orig automatic keys, then a sole remaining automatic language; otherwise abstain.
With known language, match exact code then base language, preferring manual tracks.
untrusted_source_note: Recorded as technical claims only; no source text was executed.
